title: YARA-X 1.22.0 Release, (Sun, Oct 25th)
description: YARA-X version 1.22.0 was released on October 25, 2026, introducing 11 improvements and 9 bug fixes. Among the enhancements is the addition of built-in functions to read 64-bit integers in various formats. There is no indication of security vulnerabilities or threats associated with this release.
